# stalwart_log (Data Source)

Represents a server log entry.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object.

### Read-Only

- `details` (String) Log message
- `event` (String) Event type of the log entry
- `level` (String) Severity level of the log entry
- `timestamp` (String) Timestamp of the log entry
